neighbours.label: the token ' to' right after 'having' (having to) or 'capability' (capability to); other uses of ' to' stay weak
fire: Nobody likes having to wait in line.
The clinic closed, so patients ended up having to drive an hour.
This phone has the capability to record in slow motion.
She resented having to explain herself twice.
Few labs have the capability to test for it.
Imagine having to carry all that water uphill.
He left without having to pay the fee.
We avoided having to cancel the trip.
quiet: Nobody likes to wait in line.
The clinic closed, so patients drove an hour to the city.
This phone is able to record in slow motion.
She refused to explain herself twice.
Few labs agreed to test for it.
Imagine a road from the well to the hilltop.
He left the keys next to the door.
We decided to cancel the trip.

notes: Broad pole (card flag), all 32 top peaks are ' to'. Probes: having to 0.68-1.01, capability to 1.03; want to 0.25, gave ... to her 0.24, went to 0.16, need to 0.15. Every near miss contains ' to'.
